variable.name: Root-Zone Soil Moisture
variable.desc: Water content of the root zone as a fraction of saturation (0 = dry, 1 = saturated)
variable.plain: How much water is stored in the soil around plant roots, from 0 (bone dry) to 1 (saturated).
variable.trend_means: Falling is the signature of agricultural drought — the water crops actually live on.

provenance.access: Automatic CMR discovery → authenticated OPeNDAP native-grid subset → local cache
provenance.aggregation: Native-cell polygon overlap × cos(latitude); at least 80% selected area each month
provenance.quality: Provider fill values/masks excluded; model reanalysis, not a direct measurement at every location
